attributes.action: Water facilities in the school toilets to wash themselves with water
attributes.additional_details: safe, clean, and accessible water and washing facilities for children. These facilities would allow children to wash themselves when needed, helping to protect their health, hygiene, dignity, and wellbeing.
attributes.background: I want children to access clean  water in the school toilets to wash themselves

rejection.details: All schools are required by law to provide sanitary toilet and washing facilities. It may be that you are referring to a particular situation in a particular school, in which case I would recommend speaking to your local councillor or MP.
